# Reports: List Submitted Files

Area overview and notes: [reports.md](../reports.md)

`GET /reports/submitted-files` · tenant-scoped token

Lists the files submitted under an object key, newest first. Use this to recover the `file_id` for a submission when you did not receive its events — the object key is the only identifier you hold until then.

A key can name more than one submission: re-submitting a corrected file under the same key is supported, and each is listed separately with its own `version_id`.

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | value | Yes | The object key the file was submitted under. |

**Response 200**: The submissions made under that key.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | array of object | Yes |  |
| `data[].file_id` | string (uuid) | Yes | The identifier for the submitted file. Carried on every event for the drop, and what the reports route takes. |
| `data[].path` | string | Yes | The object key the file was submitted under. |
| `data[].version_id` | string | Yes | The object version this submission was read from. Distinguishes two submissions made under the same key. |
| `data[].submitted_at` | string (date-time) | Yes | When the submission was registered. |
| `data[].state` | string | Yes | How far the submission has got: `AWAITING_ELIGIBILITY`, `GENERATING_FORMS`, `DONE`, `FAILED` or `REJECTED`. Null until both halves of the submission are in, which is the same moment the first event is sent. Nullable. |
| `data[].failure_reason` | string | Yes | Why the submission failed, when it did. One of `DECRYPT_FAILED`, `TEMPLATE_HEADER_MISMATCH`, `MALFORMED_CSV`, `FILE_TOO_LARGE`, `INTERNAL_ERROR`, `VALIDATION_FAILED`, `ELIGIBILITY_TIMEOUT` or `FORM_GENERATION_FAILED`. Nullable. |

**Errors:** 400 Bad Request · 401 Unauthorized · 429 Too Many Requests
